why: Everything a learner downloads to open the app: the page, the one script and the service worker. The script is 544 kB raw and 165 kB gzipped, and 370 kB of it (114 kB gzipped) is React's DOM renderer, which cannot be split smaller; the other 174 kB is the shell's own code and the libraries it validates with. That is over the 500 kB at which the build warns about a single chunk, so the budget is stated here, above it, rather than the warning silenced: the figure that crosses the link is the gzipped total, 167 kB, which is about 3.3 s on a 3G link of 400 kbit/s and under 1 s at 1.6 Mbit/s. The budget leaves 2.0% (raw) and 2.0% (gzipped) of room above the baseline; raising it is an edit to this file's baseline, with a reason. M7 Track H2 raised it from a baseline of 508,776 raw and 155,457 gzipped (M6-58) to the figures above: +13.6 kB raw and +3.9 kB gzipped (2.7% and 2.5%). Resuming from the device and from the server's log (the stored offset, the merge, the wall-clock port) cost 2.6 kB raw and 0.7 kB gzipped (measured on its own commit); the home, practice and report screens, their request hooks and the schemas that validate what Learning answers cost the remaining 11 kB raw and 3.1 kB gzipped. The screens are in the one script because the budget is about what crosses the link to open the app, and a learner who is sent to a report or a practice run would otherwise pay a second round trip to open it. M8 Track D (M8-15) moved the response log from `localStorage` to IndexedDB with strict durability and raised the baseline from 522,414 raw and 159,314 gzipped to the figures above: +16.0 kB raw and +4.9 kB gzipped (3.1% each). That is the store, its group-commit writer, the move of an earlier build's records, and the words for answers not yet saved or not kept; a row per event rather than one record rewritten each time is what keeps the cost of a write from growing with the attempt. M8 Track E (M8-22) added the onboarding flow and raised the baseline from 538,370 raw and 164,197 gzipped to the figures above: +10.1 kB raw and +3.2 kB gzipped (1.9% and 2.0%). That is the profile calls and the schemas that validate what Learning answers, the draft kept on the device in the response log's database (a second object store, and the upgrade that adds it without touching the log), the screen and its questions, the way back to the chapters when the syllabus has moved on, and the invitation on the home screen. The earlier text gave the shell's code as 148 kB and the figure over the link as 159 kB; those were the figures from before M7 Track H2, never brought up to date by the two raises since, and are corrected here from a build.
